rules.rationale: This macro equation expands the named encodeLoopBody proof term to the exact translated loop-body statement sequence.
This macro equation expands encodeFunctionBody to the initialization, loop, and return statements used as the named function-body proof term.
This equation defines the isVowelCode predicate as membership in the ten uppercase and lowercase ASCII vowel code points.
This is the vowel branch of the case definition for encodeCode, specifying case swap followed by a two-code-point advance.
This is the complementary non-vowel branch of the case definition for encodeCode, specifying only the case swap.
This equation is the empty-input base case of the encodeAcc recurrence.
This equation is the nonempty-input recursive case of encodeAcc, appending the encoded head code and recurring on the tail.
This wrapper equation defines encodeCodes by invoking encodeAcc with an empty output accumulator.
